settings.title: Settings
settings.previewStyleHint: Two style profiles for animated previews. The eye button in the top bar switches which one is applied to the grid -- use it to control what previews look like when hidden.
settings.sourcePasswordHint: •••••••• (leave blank to keep the current password)
settings.sourceDirectAccess: Read files directly over the network (Windows only, faster, falls back automatically if unavailable)
settings.replaceWarning: Switching backs up this source's files and tags automatically before wiping the local copy — they're restored the next time you switch back to it. Job history is not preserved either way.
settings.noSourceYet: No source configured yet. Enter a local folder path and connect.
settings.sourceStatusDirectFallback: Direct access isn't available right now — falling back to file copying.
settings.sourceSmbLockHeld: SMB lock: busy ({{duration}}) — every operation against this NAS is waiting its turn
settings.confirmRestoreDetected: Restoring replaces the current library metadata with this backup's contents. Continue?
settings.restoreStarted: Restore started — see Jobs for progress.
settings.searchLimitsHint: How many matches to show per group (tags / file names / folders) in search suggestions and unscoped search results.

playbackSettings.title: Playback
playbackSettings.hint: Both playback strategies stay available from the library — this only sets which one "Play" uses by default.

performanceSettings.title: Performance
performanceSettings.hint: How many files (bulk convert/preview jobs) or tuning variants are processed at the same time. For a single file, the same number is used to extract preview frames in parallel.
performanceSettings.hardwareStatusHint: Shows whether Intel QSV/VAAPI hardware acceleration is detected on this backend, not whether it's in use right now — actual usage shows up in the job log (🚀 messages).

networkAccess.title: Network
networkAccess.hint: Open this app from a phone on the same network. The backend and every file always stay on this PC -- the phone only shows the interface and streams video from it.
networkAccess.noAddresses: No network address was found on this PC. Connect it to Wi-Fi or Ethernet, then press Refresh.
networkAccess.scenarioLanText: Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi network (or router) as this PC, then open one of the addresses above in its browser.
networkAccess.scenarioHotspotText: Turn on the phone's mobile hotspot first, then connect this PC to that hotspot's Wi-Fi. Once connected, press Refresh above -- a new address on the hotspot's own subnet (usually 192.168.43.x or 172.20.10.x) will appear; open that one on the phone.
networkAccess.firewallText: On the first connection attempt, Windows may prompt to allow Python/Node.js through the firewall -- allow it for Private networks only.

backendHealthSettings.title: Backend status timing
backendHealthSettings.hint: How long the backend status dot (top bar) waits for a response before turning amber ("slow" -- probably just busy, e.g. converting a file) or, on the retry, red ("offline").

conversionProfiles.title: Conversion profiles
conversionProfiles.empty: No conversion profiles yet. Add one to start converting videos.
conversionProfiles.name: Profile name
conversionProfiles.hardwareAccelHint: Uses the Intel integrated GPU to encode faster. Falls back to software encoding automatically if unavailable or if a hardware encode fails.
conversionProfiles.presetHint: Trades encoding speed for compression efficiency (ffmpeg's -preset). Faster presets finish sooner but produce larger files at the same quality; slower presets take longer but compress better. Ignored when hardware encoding is active.
conversionProfiles.minSizeReductionHint: If a converted file shrinks by less than this percentage (or comes out bigger), the result is discarded and the original is kept — logged as skipped. Especially important for batch conversion.
conversionProfiles.ffmpegTimeoutHint: How long a single file's ffmpeg encode may run before it's force-killed and the job item fails. Raise this for large/slow files that legitimately take longer than an hour.
conversionProfiles.directWriteHint: Only applies to an SMB source that also has direct access enabled in its own settings: writes the converted file straight to the network share and commits it with a raw rename instead of downloading and re-uploading. Falls back automatically when a direct connection isn't available (e.g. off Windows).

tagLab.title: Tag Lab
tagLab.modelEmptyHint: No enabled AI provider entries yet. Configure one in Settings → AI providers first.
tagLab.runTimedOut: The request took too long and was cancelled client-side. The backend may still be processing it — try again in a moment.
tagLab.noTagsSuggested: The model didn't match any tags.
tagLab.statsLikeRatioTooltip: Share of liked tags among all liked/disliked tags from this model's runs (ignores tags with no vote).
tagLab.statsUnchangedTooltip: Runs applied exactly as suggested, with no tags added or removed.
tagLab.statsChangedTooltip: Runs applied with edits — tags added and/or removed before applying.
tagLab.statsNotAppliedTooltip: Runs whose suggestion was never applied.

previewSettings.title: Preview
previewSettings.animatedIntro: The animated preview is a short looping GIF shown on file and folder tiles so you can tell what's inside at a glance.
previewSettings.layoutInvalid: This layout doesn't fit the grid — adjust the enlarged tiles.

tagging.title: Tagging
tagging.vocabularyHint: The tag vocabulary is the closed set the AI scores each video against.
tagging.vocabularyEmpty: No tags yet. Add tags below to start tagging videos.
tagging.combineIntoCollage: Combine frames into one collage image
tagging.imageResolutionHint: Caps the longest side of each image sent to the AI provider, preserving its aspect ratio, whether frames are combined into a collage or sent separately.
tagging.requestTimeoutSecondsHint: How long Tag Lab waits for a direct model response before giving up.
tagging.previewHint: Runs the current settings against the most recently viewed video so you can check the sampled frames and resolution before saving.
tagging.previewNoVideo: No video available yet to generate a preview from.
tagging.userDefinedHint: A short, purely subjective list a vision model could never determine on its own — attached to a file through its own picker button, never sent to any AI provider.
tagging.userDefinedEmpty: No user-defined tags yet. Add one below, or create one on the fly from a video's picker button.
